title: Mimamsa data interchange contract v1: shared definitions
description: Reusable definitions. The .invalid host is reserved and never resolvable: every schema is loaded from local files and the validator performs no network retrieval.

contract_version.description: Contract version this record was written against (semver). Major version 1 for this schema set.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of exact bytes.

hf_revision.description: Full 40-character Hugging Face commit id. Short ids are not accepted for pinning.

doc_id.description: Stable readable identifier as used in the corpus data/meta records (lower case, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen). Section-level records append #s<section>.

relative_path.description: POSIX relative path inside a bundle or repository. No absolute paths, no parent traversal, no backslashes, no drive letters.

vault_path.description: Content-addressed vault location: vault/sha256/<first two hex>/<sha256>.

page_anchor.description: Pinpoint into a source copy. Page is 1-based and always required; character offsets refer to the derived text of that page in the named pipeline version; paragraph labels only where the source prints numbered paragraphs. Page-only anchors (source_copy_sha256 + page) are always valid. A precise span (passage_id or character offsets) is bound to one derivative only when pipeline_name, pipeline_version and derivative_text_sha256 are all present; otherwise consumers treat the anchor as page-only (warning SPAN_UNBOUND) and never resolve it against a newer derivative.

derivative_text_sha256.description: text_sha256 of the derived_text record the span offsets refer to.

field_origin.description: How a metadata field value was obtained. llm values must be shown as LLM-derived.

candidate_status.description: Verification state of any automated output. Cycle 13 releases may carry only AUTOMATED_CANDIDATE_NOT_VERIFIED or DOCUMENTARY_CHECKED (the latter only with a review reference).
